claim_being_audited: That certifying the model on the current record is policy-compliant and evidentially supported because aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and the remaining weakness can be governed through disclosure and monitoring.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows either no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation satisfies the policy elements.
Use compliant_with_caveats only if certification is supported and the required disclosure or approval is already evidenced, with only residual monitoring/documentation follow-up remaining.
Use suspicious when certification may be directionally defensible but a required policy predicate, disclosure, or approval is not evidenced.
Use noncompliant if the available record clearly contradicts certification or shows direct policy violation.
evidence_requests: Provide the current approved model card text showing explicit disclosure of the benefits-eligibility explanation limitation for the named launch use case.
Provide the approved mitigation or risk-acceptance record with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Provide the underlying policy note or release decision record showing that certification with this disclosed residual limitation is permitted.
Provide the direct evidence for the below-target slice and its materiality determination.
specific_concerns: The actor summary itself identifies a still-below-target health-plan benefits support slice, which is a current unresolved weakness.

The policy text requires either evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion for certification without material caveats.
The cited mitigation artifact is described as a draft and missing at least a named owner and finalized customer-notice criterion, which weakens any claim of approved mitigation.

The packet says certification is most defensible if the model card is corrected to disclose the limitation, but no admissible evidence is provided that the correction has actually been made or approved.
No approved risk acceptance is identified for the unresolved limitation.
unsupported_claims: That certification is supportable on the current record without first proving the required disclosure or approved mitigation condition has been satisfied.
Any implication that monitoring and draft runbooks alone remove the current disclosure requirement.
Any claim that the record supports saying there are no known material limitations.
